source.sourceVersion: JP 36.7.22 (local XAPK label; bundle hashes authoritative)
model_boundaries: Verified source fields and complete cached companion graphs; CN levels applied to JP 36.7.22 graphs are a cross-snapshot inference.
Current simulation cast-start activation, skill-duration expiry, base targeting/travel and interruption model are retained; native frame phase and projectile animation are not claimed.
Zero-event, zero-delay three-part channeling supplies semantic begin/active/end lifecycle; source animation names are retained but native artwork/frame timing is not reproduced.
Unchanged general abilities remain the existing base consumer; newly added mode general abilities, unknown fields, unsupported attack Buffs and unconsumed parameters reject the whole candidate.
Animation names, visual-only emitter lists and disabled selector flag operands are retained as source metadata; their presentation is not a second combat action.
Mode restoration follows the existing base consumer. Source mode selectors and block-count caps are bound independently of historical per-skill completion flags.

Static repeat counts use the existing shared-schema 1 + additionalTimes model. Explicit CN attack@times descriptions establish a total-count parameter; protected native repeated-shot getters and inter-shot timing remain unverified.

Finite on-hit slow/stun preserve source Buff keys and attack blackboard bindings. The shared max-expiry refresh rule is a simulation boundary; protected native DEFAULT refresh and melee Buff/body phase remain unverified.

Complete chain-lightning subtrees use one primary projectile. CN source descriptions support a total target budget including the first target; per-hop timing and nearest-target ties remain simulation conventions. Trait/module values are frozen from the live attack profile at skill start.

Cached native SetData clears the armed flag; ON_CAST_START (2) arms it. With onlyCheckOnStopAffect=false, OnTick clears the flag and adds owner Buffs once when the ability is no longer affecting. OnStopAffect does not add Buffs for this flag value.

The native methods do not branch on a named completion reason. Mapping natural completion and live attached interruption/manual completion to the next not-affecting poll is a simulation lifecycle boundary; no unconditional generic skill-end stun is inferred.

Death, retreat, removal and cancellation before cast start discard the simulation armed state. No status or deferred end action survives redeployment; native destruction-versus-tick ordering is not newly proved.
The simulation removes active skill layers before resolving after-affecting status resistance. Exact native within-frame detach/poll ordering is not claimed.

Finite status keeps its Buff key, owner source and own expiry, respects immunity and current status resistance, and survives ordinary active-mode restoration. Shared DEFAULT max-expiry refresh remains the existing simulation boundary.
This companion certificate is not whole-skill admission. Remaining active Buffs, selected attacks, selectors, probabilities and all source level keys must still close in the parent mode compiler.
JP cached component/native evidence applied to CN source levels is cross-snapshot inference. No APP extraction or native re-disassembly is performed by this compiler.

Unchanged general abilities remain the existing base consumer; newly added mode general abilities, unknown fields, unsupported attack Buffs and unconsumed parameters reject the whole candidate.
Animation names, visual-only emitter lists and disabled selector flag operands are retained as source metadata; their presentation is not a second combat action.
Mode restoration follows the existing base consumer. Source mode selectors and block-count caps are bound independently of historical per-skill completion flags.

Static repeat counts use the existing shared-schema 1 + additionalTimes model. Explicit CN attack@times descriptions establish a total-count parameter; protected native repeated-shot getters and inter-shot timing remain unverified.

Finite on-hit slow/stun preserve source Buff keys and attack blackboard bindings. The shared max-expiry refresh rule is a simulation boundary; protected native DEFAULT refresh and melee Buff/body phase remain unverified.

Complete chain-lightning subtrees use one primary projectile. CN source descriptions support a total target budget including the first target; per-hop timing and nearest-target ties remain simulation conventions. Trait/module values are frozen from the live attack profile at skill start.

Cached native SetData clears the armed flag; ON_CAST_START (2) arms it. With onlyCheckOnStopAffect=false, OnTick clears the flag and adds owner Buffs once when the ability is no longer affecting. OnStopAffect does not add Buffs for this flag value.

The native methods do not branch on a named completion reason. Mapping natural completion and live attached interruption/manual completion to the next not-affecting poll is a simulation lifecycle boundary; no unconditional generic skill-end stun is inferred.

Death, retreat, removal and cancellation before cast start discard the simulation armed state. No status or deferred end action survives redeployment; native destruction-versus-tick ordering is not newly proved.
The simulation removes active skill layers before resolving after-affecting status resistance. Exact native within-frame detach/poll ordering is not claimed.

Finite status keeps its Buff key, owner source and own expiry, respects immunity and current status resistance, and survives ordinary active-mode restoration. Shared DEFAULT max-expiry refresh remains the existing simulation boundary.
This companion certificate is not whole-skill admission. Remaining active Buffs, selected attacks, selectors, probabilities and all source level keys must still close in the parent mode compiler.
JP cached component/native evidence applied to CN source levels is cross-snapshot inference. No APP extraction or native re-disassembly is performed by this compiler.
